articles.title_en: Tesla Cybercab orders open at $29,990 + $299/mo, only in Robotaxi zones
articles.summary_en: Tesla is now inviting “select customers” to buy a Cybercab for personal use at $29,990, but the car won’t move unless you also pay $299 a month for an “Autonomy Subscription.” And it only works inside Tesla’s Robotaxi service areas in Texas and Florida, the same geofences that have turned out to be significantly smaller than what Tesla advertises. more…
